texts.ee7a2570eb28: The Standard care versus Celecoxib Outcome Trial (SCOT Trial) The primary objective of the study is to compare the cardiovascular safety of celecoxib and traditional NSAIDs. The secondary objective of the study is to compare the gastrointestinal safety of celecoxib and traditional NSAIDs. The present proposal seeks to compare the cardiovascular and gastrointestinal safety and effectiveness of a strategy of initial randomisation to treatment with the selective COX-2 inhibitor celecoxib or to ‘usual care’ with their current non-selective NSAID therapy (with or without cyto-protection with ulcer healing drug use in either celecoxib or ‘usual care’ limbs). Data access is restricted to those named in section 7 of this agreement. Any changes will be notified to the HSCIC.
